download_completeness.boundary_basis: UI manifest query dates; observed record min/max dates do not establish coverage

qingke_input.path: 原始数据打包_20260401/清科政府引导基金投资事件截止到2024年/2015-2024投资事件_附基金级别分类注册地区_扩展匹配.csv

rules.company_match: NFKC + whitespace removal only, then full-string equality; literal equality flagged separately
rules.input_rows: Only choice_events_*.xlsx formal batches. Diagnostic choice_probe_* files remain raw and are listed as ignored. Rows below the event header exclude blanks, repeated headers and 数据来源 footers; metadata retained separately in source_notes.csv.
rules.government_candidates: Company overlap describes financing history; name+year/date and exact known fund tokens are review candidates. Ownership and government status remain unknown.
rules.qingke_header: Exclude only the explicit shifted-header signature 融资主体=基金全称, 投资时间=投资类型, 基金全称=上级机构全称, 轮次=投资金额(USD/M); preserve source record number and raw values separately.
rules.investor_tokens: Split top-level comma/Chinese comma/dunhao/semicolon/newline; parentheses preserved. No fuzzy names, role inference, legal-entity inference or investor-amount allocation.
rules.monetary_amounts: Keep original cell value and currency; numeric cells copied without conversion. No missing-to-zero or midpoint imputation.
rules.duplicate_policy: All source rows retained; content fingerprint excludes only the batch sequence. Identical-content frequency is diagnostic.
rules.round_flags: Supplier financing labels classified separately; no inference from round to government identity or firm maturity.
rules.region_and_tags: Region, industry and innovation labels retained as exported; historical effective dates are not supplied.
